answer: Chrono-ID Attestation. 1) Users register, submitting verifiable real-world identity proofs to a decentralized oracle. 2) Periodically, users receive a unique cryptographic challenge via a zephyr message, requiring a timely response. 3) Successful re-attestations create a growing vine of trust for each user, visible as a ripple effect across the network. Cost for N identities is $5 N + 0.001 N^2. Failure occurs if an attacker controls a majority of oracle nodes, allowing them to forge re-attestation signals. This is like a lighthouse beacon, guiding only genuine ships through the fog.
